in_sanskrit.name: गोर्धन
in_sanskrit.meaning: Cowherd, protector, one who nourishes cows
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गो (go) - cow, रध् (rdh) - to protect, धन (dhana) - wealth, resources; The one who protects and nourishes cows and their wealth

in_hindi.name: गोर्धन
in_hindi.long_meaning: गो (go) - cow, धान (dhana) - grain, धन (dhana) - wealth; A person who takes care of cows and their resources

in_tamil.name: கோர்தன
in_tamil.long_meaning: கோ (ko) - cow, தன (than) - self, ர் (r) - protector, தன் (than) - self, கள் (kal) - nourisher; One who protects and nourishes cows and their resources

in_telugu.name: గోర్ధన
in_telugu.long_meaning: గో (go) - cow, ర్ధన్ (rdhana) - protector, ధనం (dhana) - wealth; One who protects and takes care of cows and their resources

in_marathi.name: Gordhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cowherd, One who serves
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gordhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gordhan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gopala’ which means 'cowherd'. This name is used for a boy and signifies one who serves, protects, and nurtures, just like a cowherd taking care of his cattle.
